$schema_note: Canonical machine-readable research dataset for Karwan-e-Khizr. See TRANSIT_RESEARCH.md, SOURCES.md and DATA_GAPS.md for full context. Every record carries 'source' and 'confidence'. Confidence values: OFFICIAL, VERIFIED, OSM-DERIVED, RECONSTRUCTED, INFERRED, APPROXIMATE, UNKNOWN. null fields are deliberate - no field in this file was fabricated to fill a gap.

operators.name: Punjab Mass Transit Authority (PMTA)
operators.notes: Manages the Red Line (the original 2015 corridor, Pak Secretariat - Saddar).

operators.name: Capital Development Authority (CDA) / Capital Mass Transit Authority (CMTA)
operators.notes: CDA manages Orange, Blue and Green Metrobus lines plus the CDA feeder-route network (FR-01..FR-15+) inside Islamabad. CMTA was created to operate the non-Red-Line network; in practice CDA and CMTA are referenced near-interchangeably in public sources. Treated as ONE agency here pending a clearer operator-of-record split; see DATA_GAPS.md.
operators.source: Wikipedia: Rawalpindi-Islamabad Metrobus; CDA Transit Map PDF

service_calendars.notes: No official published service-calendar exceptions (holidays, reduced-Sunday-service, etc.) were found for the Metrobus network. All secondary sources describe uniform daily 06:15-22:00 operation. Shaheed Chowk - Shakarpariyan), each hourly - these are modeled as a separate weekend-only calendar below.

trips.notes: This is ONE real, officially-published trip pattern (stop-level arrival/departure offsets, seconds from trip start) taken verbatim from the cited CDA PDF. Multiple consecutive trips on that PDF were checked and confirmed to be EXACT time-shifts of this same pattern by 'headway_min' - so every real trip for this route/direction/day can be reconstructed by repeating this pattern every headway_min minutes from first_trip_start to last_trip_start (total_trips_per_day trips), without inventing any new stop-level timing.
